integrity: All original analytical arguments and named prior results are distinguished. Finite symbolic and numerical checks supplement but do not substitute for the proof. Priority is assessed against inspected sources, not independently certified.
limitations: Sharp transverse positivity, location of the first boundary zeros and the nearest-zero asymptotics are proved only for the 4D Euclidean bipyramid. An optimal finite-parameter equal-volume-ball cutoff and analogous exact constants in other dimensions are not established.
title: The exact four-dimensional Fourier-zero strip of elongated Euclidean bipyramids
